Asobi Review 1.0 (build 1611) Oct 15, 2026

  • Kitsu against the disk. Kitsu… in Shots on Disk sets the sequence’s shots in Kitsu beside its folders and fixes what you tick: a shot renamed on disk renamed in Kitsu, a shot merged into another marked omitted, a shot back in the cut marked in the cut again, a folder with plates and no Kitsu shot made in Kitsu. Try shows what fixing would do without doing it. Nothing is deleted in Kitsu.
  • Move a shot to another sequence. The rename sheet’s Sequence field moves a shot and its plates to another sequence of the job, with a number there (SST_RAI_040 becomes SST_BOU_045). Written down and undoable like a rename.
  • A shot cut in two. In Pull Plates the new half reads “New, split from 040”; Swap Names gives it 040 instead, when the work on 040 belongs to that half.
  • A folder two tools wrote into gets a Server Script: Asobi writes a script for the server that sets aside the frames that don’t belong, by their exact names, with a dry run and an undo. It never moves them itself over the Mac’s view of the server.
  • A shot the cut brings back keeps its number, and Kitsu… marks it in the cut again.
Earlier updates

1.0 (build 1476) Oct 12, 2026

  • DPX sequences play. 8, 10, 12 and 16-bit DPX files open and play like any other image sequence, read as the color space set for DPX in Settings, Color.
  • A tall floating Playlist with thumbnails could stop the app. Fixed.
  • Small fixes.

1.0 (build 1441) Oct 11, 2026

  • Network is in the Review menu. Review ▸ Network; it was under Window. It is also in the right-click Review menu.
  • A playlist on a network drive no longer slows the window. Whether each clip's file is there is checked in the background.
  • Locate Media… reads a folder in the background. A line above the toolbar says how far it has got.

Asobi Review 1.0 (build 1608) Oct 15, 2026

  • Merge a shot into another. When a transition makes two shots one: in Shots on Disk, click the shot to merge from and choose Merge Into. Each of its PLs becomes the other shot’s next free PL (020’s PL01 becomes 010’s PL02), with its versions, records, frame maps, proxies, source_info.txt lines and review movies renamed to match.
  • The shot merged from keeps its work, with a note saying where its plates went; its number is never given again. Written down in 00_ADMIN/_RENAMES before anything moves, and undone with Undo Last Merge, like a rename.
  • Undo removes the folders a move made, so a rename or merge undone leaves the shots exactly as they were.

Asobi Review 1.0 (build 1606) Oct 15, 2026

  • Rename a shot. In Shots on Disk, click a row and choose Rename to give its shot another number: its plates, records, frame maps, proxies, source_info.txt, .metadata.json, plate review movies and folder, and the sequence’s list of names. A number another shot has, or had, is refused.
  • Written down first. Every step is recorded in the job’s 00_ADMIN/_RENAMES before anything moves, and Undo Last Rename puts it all back. Work under work/ and renders/ is listed, with the scripts that point at the old path, and never changed; Kitsu still calls the shot by its old number.
  • Fixed: a shot whose PL holds two clips (a plate pulled again from another clip) keeps its other PLs and isn’t pulled again for nothing.
